speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you have presented with a breast mass; to help me understand your condition, how long have you noticed this lump, and is it painful to the touch?

speaker: Patient
text: 48-year-old woman. The patient noticed a mass in her left breast 4 weeks ago, which has rapidly increased in size. She denies any recent trauma or infections. No history of similar complaints in the past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Cancer (Left Breast)

The rapid growth of a breast mass over four weeks is highly concerning for malignancy. Given your age and the aggressive nature of the enlargement, I am requesting an urgent diagnostic mammogram and ultrasound, along with a tissue biopsy, to confirm the diagnosis.
